# Azure DNS
> Azure DNS is Microsoft’s cloud-hosted DNS service for hosting, managing, and resolving public and private DNS domains.

Azure DNS documentation is primarily hosted within Microsoft Learn and covers public DNS zones, private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, alias records, delegation, automation, and integration with Azure networking services.

## Overview
- [Azure DNS documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/): Central documentation hub for Azure DNS concepts, how-to guides, and references.
- [What is Azure DNS?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-overview): Overview of Azure DNS features, benefits, and public DNS hosting capabilities.
- [Azure DNS FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-faq): Frequently asked questions about Azure DNS behavior, limits, and supported scenarios.
- [Azure DNS pricing](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/dns/): Pricing details for public DNS zones, queries, and related service usage.
- [Azure DNS SLA](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/support/legal/sla/dns/v1_0/): Service-level agreement for Azure DNS availability and service commitments.

## Public DNS Zones
- [Create a DNS zone and record](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-getstarted-portal): Quickstart for creating a public DNS zone and adding records in the Azure portal.
- [Delegate a domain to Azure DNS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-delegate-domain-azure-dns): Steps to update registrar name servers and delegate a domain to Azure DNS.
- [Manage DNS zones](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-operations-recordsets-portal): Manage public DNS zones and record sets using the Azure portal.
- [Manage DNS records and record sets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-operations-recordsets-cli): Create and update DNS record sets using Azure CLI.
- [Import and export a DNS zone file](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-import-export): Import BIND-style zone files into Azure DNS and export existing zones.
- [Alias records overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-alias): Use alias records to reference Azure resources without hard-coded IP addresses.

## Private DNS
- [Azure Private DNS documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-dns-overview): Overview of Azure Private DNS for internal name resolution in virtual networks.
- [Quickstart: Create an Azure private DNS zone](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-dns-getstarted-portal): Create a private DNS zone and link it to a virtual network.
- [Virtual network links](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-dns-virtual-network-links): Understand registration and resolution virtual network links for private DNS zones.
- [Autoregistration overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-dns-autoregistration): Automatically register virtual machine DNS records in linked private DNS zones.
- [Private DNS scenarios](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-dns-scenarios): Common deployment patterns and name resolution scenarios for private DNS.
- [Private DNS FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-faq-private): Frequently asked questions about Azure Private DNS capabilities and limitations.

## DNS Private Resolver
- [Azure DNS Private Resolver overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-resolver-overview): Overview of managed inbound and outbound DNS resolution for hybrid networks.
- [Quickstart: Create a DNS Private Resolver](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-resolver-get-started-portal): Deploy a DNS Private Resolver with endpoints and rulesets in the portal.
- [Endpoints and rulesets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-resolver-endpoints-rulesets): Learn how inbound endpoints, outbound endpoints, and forwarding rulesets work.
- [DNS forwarding rulesets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-resolver-forwarding-rulesets): Configure forwarding rulesets for conditional DNS forwarding across linked virtual networks.
- [Architecture and scenarios](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-resolver-scenarios): Reference architectures and hybrid DNS resolution scenarios using Private Resolver.
- [Private Resolver FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-resolver-faq): Frequently asked questions about deployment, limits, and supported configurations.

## Automation and CLI
- [Azure DNS with Azure CLI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-operations-dnszones-cli): Manage Azure DNS zones using Azure CLI commands.
- [Azure DNS with Azure PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-operations-dnszones-powershell): Manage DNS zones and records using Azure PowerShell cmdlets.
- [Azure DNS with ARM templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-get-started-template): Deploy Azure DNS resources using Azure Resource Manager templates.
- [Azure DNS with Terraform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-zone-terraform): Provision Azure DNS resources using Terraform examples and guidance.
- [Azure CLI dns reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/network/dns): Command reference for Azure CLI public DNS zone and record operations.
- [Azure CLI private-dns reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/network/private-dns): Command reference for Azure CLI private DNS zone operations.

## API and SDK Reference
- [REST API reference for DNS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/dns/): REST API reference for Azure DNS zones, record sets, and operations.
- [REST API reference for Private DNS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/privatedns/): REST API reference for Azure Private DNS zones and virtual network links.
- [REST API reference for DNS Private Resolver](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/dnsresolver/): REST API reference for DNS Private Resolver endpoints and forwarding rulesets.
- [Azure SDK for .NET](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/overview/azure/resourcemanager.dns-readme): .NET management SDK overview for Azure DNS resources.
- [Azure SDK for Python](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/mgmt-dns-readme): Python management SDK overview for Azure DNS operations.
- [Azure SDK for JavaScript](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/javascript/api/overview/azure/arm-dns-readme): JavaScript management SDK overview for Azure DNS resources.

## Tutorials and Guidance
- [Host your domain in Azure DNS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-delegate-domain-azure-dns): Tutorial-style guidance for delegating an internet domain to Azure DNS.
- [Use alias records to point to Azure resources](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-alias): Guidance for mapping DNS names to Azure public IPs and Traffic Manager profiles.
- [Name resolution for VMs and role instances](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-network/virtual-networks-name-resolution-for-vms-and-role-instances): Azure networking guidance covering DNS resolution options for virtual networks.
- [Integrate Private DNS with virtual networks](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/private-dns-virtual-network-links): Guidance for linking private zones to one or more virtual networks.
- [Hybrid DNS with Private Resolver](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-private-resolver-overview): Guidance for hybrid and cross-network DNS resolution using managed resolver infrastructure.

## Reliability, Limits, and Operations
- [Azure subscription and service limits for DNS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-resource-manager/management/azure-subscription-service-limits#azure-dns-limits): Service limits and quotas for Azure DNS resources and operations.
- [Azure DNS metrics and diagnostics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/dns/dns-monitoring): Monitor Azure DNS using metrics, logs, and diagnostic settings.
- [Resource health overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/service-health/resource-health-overview): Understand Azure resource health signals relevant to DNS resource operations.
- [Azure status](https://status.azure.com/): Current Azure platform status and regional service availability information.
- [Well-Architected Framework: Reliability](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/well-architected/reliability/): Reliability design guidance applicable to DNS-dependent Azure architectures.

## Related Azure Networking Services
- [Azure Traffic Manager documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/traffic-manager/): Global DNS-based traffic distribution service documentation.
- [Azure Front Door documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/frontdoor/): Global application delivery network documentation often used with custom DNS domains.
- [Azure Virtual Network documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-network/): Core virtual networking documentation relevant to private DNS integration.
- [Azure Load Balancer documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/load-balancer/): Load balancing documentation for services commonly referenced by DNS records.
- [Azure Application Gateway documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/application-gateway/): Application delivery and ingress documentation for DNS-backed web applications.
